name: harness-pro-max
description: Guardrails, token and cost control, limits, multi-agent workflows and verification for coding agents
skillInstructions: Kimi Code tool mapping for Harness Pro Max skills: when a skill says to ask the user, use AskUserQuestion; to track tasks, use TodoList; to dispatch a subagent, use Agent with subagent_type coder (implementation and review), explore (read-only search) or plan (design); to invoke another skill, use Skill. Use Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, FetchURL and WebSearch by their exposed names.

interface.shortDescription: Guardrails, token and cost control, limits, multi-agent workflows and verification for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Harness Pro Max guides and guards agent work: brainstorming, plans, test-driven development, systematic debugging, agent teams, code review and release workflows, plus a shell-aware policy engine, token guards, output and input limits, budgets and cost analytics.
